title: Renal system, fluids and electrolytes
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Integrate kidney anatomy and embryology, filtration and clearance, tubular transport, water and sodium balance, potassium, calcium and phosphate, acid–base physiology and disorders, acute and chronic kidney disease, glomerular disease, infections and stones, and renal drugs.

blocks.deliverable: Compute creatinine clearance and filtration fraction.
Work up hyponatremia by volume status and osmolality.
Treat hyperkalemia in the right order.
Week 7 midterm; use the anion gap and Winter's formula.
Match diuretics to their sites and electrolyte effects.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Electrolyte and acid–base casebook: work up eight supplied cases with the anion gap, the osmolal gap and the compensation formulas.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
